topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: So, my so-called best friend is packing up and shoving off to the other side of the country. How considerate. Didn't even bother to mention it until the moving truck was booked and the boxes were half-packed. Oh, I should be thrilled, right? Because moving is always such a grand adventure, especially when you leave everyone who cares about you behind. Well, I have some packing to do too. Gotta find a way to squeeze my heart into a box, I suppose, since it's obviously not welcome here anymore.というのは冗談ですが、私は本当に-u-
